costNote: Hosting the cloud platform and supporting subscribers — just $176M against $2.05B of revenue. Software economics: 91 cents of every dollar survives as gross profit.

opex.name: Marketing & sales
opex.note: The sales reorganization year — Autodesk is shifting more selling to partners and its own transaction platform. Still the biggest single cost.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building AI features into AutoCAD, Revit, Fusion and the Forma platform.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Finance, legal, HR and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization & restructuring, net
opex.note: $13M of amortization on purchased intangibles, net of a $1M restructuring credit.

oneTimers.label: MaintainX acquisition
oneTimers.text: Autodesk closed its MaintainX acquisition and raised FY27 billings/revenue guidance partly on its contribution — while flagging about $45M of related transaction costs in its cash-flow outlook.

segments.name: Design
segments.note: AutoCAD, Revit and the design-side portfolios — 83% of revenue. Grew 16% (14% in constant currency).

segments.name: Make
segments.note: Construction and manufacturing-execution software (Autodesk Construction Cloud, Fusion operations) — the fastest grower at +26%, aided by MaintainX.

sources.label: Autodesk Q2 FY2027 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Aug 27, 2026)

takeaways.text: GAAP EPS leapt from $1.46 to $2.33 — a year ago Autodesk was absorbing sales-model transition costs. Non-GAAP EPS was $3.30, and GAAP operating margin hit 29%.
takeaways.title: GAAP profit caught up

takeaways.text: The 'Make' portfolio (construction + manufacturing execution) is small but growing 26% — the strategic second engine behind the Design core.
takeaways.title: Make is the growth engine

takeaways.text: Free cash flow of $561M in the quarter, up 24%. FY27 FCF guidance was narrowed: stronger underlying cash generation, partly spent on MaintainX deal and financing costs.
takeaways.title: Cash flow compounding

verdict: Textbook software leverage: 16% growth at a 91% gross margin turned into a 60% jump in GAAP EPS.
